decision: Continue using v0.17.1 with existing Orca IQ4 support and adopted A; retain normal settings.

open_issue.description: Observed local Prefill rates fell 1.7–5.0% against retained v0.16 samples. Cause and repeatability are unresolved; neither a confirmed version regression nor dismissed as noise. Continued adoption does not close this issue or waive quality/timing checks.
open_issue.observations: One warmed observation at each of eight depths per workload. Means cover different depths, not repeated trials.
open_issue.existing_followups: Focused 0K/4K/32K prose control: 4K improved, 0K and 32K remained lower. Recalibrated 32K input differs from the formal sweep, although the control old/new pair matches. All controls remain separate from formal means.
open_issue.closure_requirement: Record matched relevant-history evidence, exact request/token/cache work and per-request Prefill/TTFT phases. Do not close on aggregate averages or changed workloads alone; retain inconclusive outcomes.
